blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A subcommittee of ranking House lawmakers on late Thursday boosted funding for crucial social welfare programs, including the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s (DSWD) crisis intervention scheme to help vulnerable families cushion the economic impact of expected dry spells driven by El Nino. The Budget Amendments Review Sub-committee (BARSc) augmented funding for the DSWD’s Assistance for Individuals in Crisis (AICS) by 25.8 billion, lifting its proposed budget to P58.8 billion from the P33 billion originally proposed in the executive’s spending plan.
